name: session_get
description: Get detailed information about a specific session including its metadata, message content, and conversation history. This tool allows agents to read and investigate any session by ID, enabling them to understand what was done in specific sessions, subsections, or canvas work. Use this when you need to examine the complete content and context of a particular session rather than just searching for sessions.

session_id.description: ID of the session to retrieve

include_messages.description: Include the full message content of the session

message_limit.description: Maximum number of messages to include (default: all)

include_tool_calls.description: Include tool call parts in messages
